colors.strict_rule: Use ONLY Olive #66734A, Light Cream #F5F0E6, White #FFFFFF. Do NOT use black, gray, or any other color.

headings.usage: H1, H2, Section titles, large editorial text. Use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, small UI text, buttons. Use tracking-wide for uppercase labels.

layout_and_spacing.general: Huge whitespace, generous padding. Use py-24, py-32, or py-40 for section spacing.
layout_and_spacing.grid: Asymmetric, non-standard layouts. Avoid generic 3-column equal grids. Use offset images, overlapping text, and varied column spans (bento-style).
layout_and_spacing.borders: Rounded corners where appropriate (e.g., rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards).
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align text blocks for readability, center large editorial impact statements.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle, diffused shadows for lifted cards. Example: shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(102,115,74,0.08)]
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero video/image must have a Cream (#F5F0E6) or Olive (#66734A) overlay with mix-blend-mode or opacity to ensure text contrast without losing cinematic feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Clean, smooth, editorial luxury. No generic SaaS gradients.

motion.animations: Framer Motion. Slow text reveals (line-by-line masked reveals). Scroll-triggered fade up and slow scale. Video expansion on scroll for 'Bros Moment'.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover zoom/lift on drink cards. Magnetic or smooth background color shifts on buttons.

media.guidelines: Videos muted, autoplay, looping. Clearly mark video placeholders. Use premium photography. NEVER use placeholder text for images.

hero_video_poster.description: Espresso dripping into a porcelain mug from a steel machine

drink_espresso.description: Espresso dripping from a metal portafilter into a yellow cup

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis (or lenis), @phosphor-icons/react. Import Cormorant Garamond and DM Sans in index.css. DO NOT USE ANY OTHER COLORS EXCEPT #66734A, #F5F0E6, #FFFFFF.

sections.navigation: Minimalist header. Sticky, blurred background (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F5F0E6]/70). Left: 'BROS CAFE' text logo. Center/Right: HOME, MENU, ABOUT, WHAT'S NEW, LOYALTY, and a CTA. Animated mobile menu overlay.
sections.hero: Full-screen cinematic hero. Use an HTML5 <video> tag (with muted, loop, autoplay) using the provided poster image, or use the image with a slow scale animation. Overlay of Cream or Olive (e.g., bg-black/10 or bg-[#F5F0E6]/20) to ensure text readability. Massive H1 'BROS CAFE / Good coffee. Good people.' Use framer-motion for line-by-line reveal on mount (overflow-hidden wrapper around text lines). Buttons: [EXPLORE] and [GET LOYALTY CARD].
sections.coffee_cards: Heading 'COFFEE, THE WAY WE LIKE IT.' Grid of 4 editorial drink cards. Cards have an image, title, and elegant description. On hover: subtle zoom of image and card lift.
sections.bros_moment: Section titled 'THE BROS MOMENT'. Huge typography 'TAKE A MINUTE.' A video/image placeholder container that starts small in the center and expands to full width/height on scroll using useScroll. Reveals secondary text 'Coffee tastes better together.' + 'Come hang out.'
sections.about: Title 'MORE THAN COFFEE.' Personal story text and offset, asymmetric images. High editorial feel with generous margins.
sections.menu_preview: Clean text-based menu (Coffee, Cold drinks, Pastries, Specials) + [VIEW MENU] button. Minimalist, tabulated list.
sections.loyalty_cta: Bold section. Text 'YOUR COFFEE SHOULD COUNT.' and 'Buy 4 coffees. Get your next one FREE.' with a large placeholder CTA button.
sections.whats_new: 'FROM THE BROS' editorial cards. Small news snippets or articles.
sections.community_collage: Asymmetric photo collage overlapping the boundaries. Use 3-4 images of lifestyle/fashion/coffee.
sections.marquee: Slow editorial marquee. E.g., 'GOOD COFFEE. GOOD PEOPLE. • '. Use react-fast-marquee or framer-motion.
sections.footer: Minimalist. 'BROS CAFE'. Links, copyright, simple layout.
sections.general: Add numbered manifesto chapters and numbered section labels (e.g., '01', '02') in a small, wide-spaced serif font.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
